Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Packaging Engineer Consultant to provide project-based packaging expertise, leadership, and oversight for our client’s Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) in Switzerland. This is a remote consulting opportunity; travel to Switzerland is not required. The consultant will serve as the primary packaging subject matter expert (SME), overseeing the planning, design review and development, procurement, qualification, and execution of packaging activities at the CMO.

The successful candidate will work closely with the CMO and internal project stakeholders to ensure packaging activities are appropriately planned, technically sound, compliant with applicable regulatory requirements, and executed according to project timelines and quality expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Provide overall packaging SME leadership and technical oversight including planning and execution of primary and secondary packaging activities, such as:
Single-unit punch-out processes for separating individual BFS vials
Active and buffer unit foil pouching
Secondary packaging activities, including:
Cartoning
IFU (Instructions for Use) insertion
TE seal application
Other packaging operations as required by the project
Provide SME support for the identification, selection, and procurement of packaging equipment required for the project
Provide expert oversight of packaging equipment specifications, vendor interactions, installation, and readiness, as appropriate
Provide overall vendor oversight and packaging-related support, ensuring vendors and the CMO remain aligned with project requirements, timelines, quality expectations, and technical standards
Review packaging designs, processes, specifications, procedures, and documentation as needed
Identify potential packaging risks, technical issues, and project constraints and provide recommendations and mitigation strategies
Support packaging-related investigations, deviations, change controls, and problem-solving activities, as needed
Provide technical input and support for regulatory filings and regulatory responses related to packaging activities, as required
Participate in project meetings, design reviews, technical discussions, and CMO/vendor meetings as the packaging SME
Ensure packaging activities are appropriately documented and aligned with applicable GMP, quality, regulatory, and company requirements
Provide expert guidance to the CMO as it plans and executes packaging activities through project milestones and commercial/clinical readiness, as applicable
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree plus 10 years of relevant packaging engineering or pharmaceutical packaging experience, with significant experience in a senior or SME capacity
Demonstrated experience overseeing packaging activities at a CMO/CDMO
Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical packaging processes, equipment, and packaging operations
Experience with BFS vial packaging and/or comparable unit-dose pharmaceutical packaging processes strongly preferred
Experience with foil pouching, cartoning, IFU insertion, sealing, and other secondary packaging operations
Experience supporting the selection and procurement of packaging equipment and working with equipment suppliers/vendors
Strong understanding of GMP, quality systems, and regulatory expectations related to pharmaceutical packaging
Demonstrated ability to manage external vendors and CMO relationships from a technical and project oversight perspective
Ability to provide clear technical direction and make sound recommendations while operating in a consulting/oversight capacity
